info.title: Placepoint API
info.summary: Norwegian and Swedish property, company and area data over one REST API.
info.description:
The Placepoint API is one REST API for the data behind Placepoint Fusion:
properties keyed on matrikkelnummer, companies keyed on country code
and organisasjonsnummer, areas, and subscriptions for change events.

Conventions, authentication, identifiers and a quickstart:
https://docs.placepoint.no/developer/guide/. Norwegian product pages per
endpoint group: https://docs.placepoint.no/api/.

servers.description: Production. Same host as today's Data API; api.placepoint.no takes over once the PropCloud APIs behind it are shut down.

get.description: Lists the API with its status, scopes and links to spec, docs and changelog, per the IETF api-catalog draft.
The OpenAPI document for the running version, same artifact as the deployed code.

Returns the properties that match an address text, best match first,
each with its cadastreId so the rest of the API can be called. Norway
matches against Kartverket's adresseregister; Sweden against
Lantmäteriet via Combify. Partial addresses return several matches.

Product page: [Adresser til matrikkelnummer](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/adresser).

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: URL-encoded address text, e.g. "Karl Johans gate 1, Oslo".

get.description:
Returns what sits at a WGS84 coordinate: the property whose registered
boundary covers the point (if any), its buildings, and the addresses
on it. A coordinate that falls outside every registered property
returns no property and empty buildings and addresses arrays.

Product page: [Fra koordinat til eiendom](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/koordinater).

schema.description: The covering property, its buildings and its addresses.

get.description:
Returns a property by its cadastreId, with links to its sub-resources:
sections, buildings and units.

Product page: [Eiendommer](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/eiendommer).

Lists the sections (eierseksjoner) registered on the property, each
with its ownership share and owners. Owners are always returned, but
a Person owner's name is included only when the caller also holds the
person:read scope; without it, name is omitted and only birthYear
(when known) is returned.

Product page: [Eiendommer](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/eiendommer).

Lists the buildings (bygninger) registered on the property, from
Matrikkelen for Norway and the corresponding Swedish building
register via Combify.

Product page: [Bygg og bruksenheter](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/bygg).

Lists the residential and commercial units (bruksenheter) registered
within the property's buildings, each with its own address.

Product page: [Bygg og bruksenheter](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/bygg).

post.description:
Looks up up to 100 cadastreIds in one call and returns whichever
properties resolve, plus a notFound list for the rest. Each requested
id counts as one call against the property:read quota, whether or
not it resolves. Idempotency-Key replays the same response to a
retried request for 24 hours. A 404 means the country's cadastre
register itself is not served; an individual id that does not
resolve within a served register comes back in notFound, not as a 404.

Product page: [Eiendommer](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/eiendommer).

cadastreIds.description: Cadastre identifiers to look up, one per id against the quota.

schema.description: Found properties plus any ids that did not resolve.

items.description: Properties found, one per resolved id.

notFound.description: Cadastre ids that did not resolve to a property.

get.description:
Lists the rights holders (hjemmelshavere) registered on the property
as a whole, across all its sections. Owners are always returned, but
a Person owner's name is included only when the caller also holds
the person:read scope; without it, name is omitted and only
birthYear (when known) is returned, matching the sections endpoint.

Product page: [Eiere](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/eiere).

Lists the companies with a registered business address on the
property, sourced from Brønnøysundregistrenes Enhetsregisteret and
refreshed nightly. verification.source states whether a tenant is
confirmed by the register, observed from other signals, or both;
confidence and lastSeenAt qualify how current the signal is.

Product page: [Leietakere](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/leietakere).

Lists recorded sales (tinglyste hjemmelsoverganger) of the property
or a share of it, newest first, from Kartverket's Tinglysing.
Buyers and sellers are returned as owners; a Person owner's name is
included only with the person:read scope, otherwise it is omitted
and only birthYear (when known) is returned.

Product page: [Transaksjoner](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/transaksjoner).

schema.description: Transactions wrapped in an object, cursor-paginated.

items.description: One entry per transaction, newest first.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

get.description:
Lists recent sales of similar nearby properties, ranked by
similarity, to support a valuation. Each entry carries every
Transaction field plus its distance from the property, its price
per square metre, and a similarity score. Buyers and sellers are
owners; a Person owner's name is included only with the
person:read scope.

Product page: [Sammenlignbare salg](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/sammenlignbare-salg).

schema.description: Comparable transactions wrapped in an object.

items.description: One entry per comparable transaction, most similar first.

get.description:
Returns the current estimated value and rent for the property: a
point estimate with a low-high range for both sale value and rent
per square metre per year, the valuation method, and when it was
computed.

Product page: [Verdivurdering](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/verdivurdering).

Lists the energy certificates issued for the property's buildings:
energiattester from Enova's register for Norway, energideklarationer
from Boverket for Sweden.

Product page: [Energiattester](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/energi).

schema.description: Energy certificates wrapped in an object.

get.description:
Lists environmental certifications held for the property's
buildings, such as BREEAM-NOR at completion or BREEAM In-Use for
an operating building.

Product page: [Miljøsertifiseringer](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/sertifiseringer).

Lists the reguleringsplaner that cover the property, proposed,
adopted or repealed, each with its permitted purpose and any
planning documents.

Product page: [Reguleringsplaner og utnyttelse](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/reguleringsplaner).

schema.description: Zoning plans wrapped in an object.

get.description:
Returns the permitted and built utilization (utnyttelsesgrad) for
the property under its zoning plan: allowed built-over percentage
of plot area, allowed and built gross floor area, and what basis
the figures rest on.

Product page: [Reguleringsplaner og utnyttelse](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/reguleringsplaner).

Lists building-permit cases for the property, newest first. Norway
is sourced from the kommune case archives Placepoint holds; Sweden
is bygglov cases via Combify.

Product page: [Byggesaker](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/byggesaker).

schema.description: Building permits wrapped in an object, cursor-paginated.

items.description: One entry per case, newest first.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

get.description:
Lists heftelser (encumbrances) registered on the property:
mortgages, easements, restraints on disposal and other tinglyste
rights.

Product page: [Heftelser](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/heftelser).

Returns the assessed risk level for flood, landslide, quick clay
(kvikkleire) and radon at the property. source names the
leverandor behind each assessment: NVE for flood, landslide and
quick clay, DSA (Direktoratet for strålevern og atomsikkerhet) for
radon. A level of UNKNOWN means the underlying register does not
yet cover the property, not that the property is judged risk-free.

Product page: [Naturfare](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/risiko).

quickClay.note: Randsone av kvikkleiresone, ikke utredet i detalj.

get.description:
Returns the borettslag, sameie or aksjelag the property's unit
belongs to, if any: the organization, its legal form, unit count,
shared debt (fellesgjeld) and its latest filed financial statement.
Returns 404 when the property is not organized under a housing
cooperative.

Product page: [Borettslag og sameier](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/borettslag).

Lists documents tied to the property: zoning-plan text, building
case decisions, sales prospectuses and other tinglyste or public
documents. Each downloadUrl is a signed URL valid for 15 minutes;
request the list again for a fresh link once it expires.

Product page: [Dokumenter](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/dokumenter).

Returns the property's registered boundary as a GeoJSON Feature.
The underlying boundary data is not yet available for every
kommune; a property in an uncovered kommune returns 404.

Product page: [Tomtegrenser](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/kart).

Returns one building's ground footprint as a GeoJSON Feature.
properties.heightM and properties.floors carry the building's
height in meters and floor count alongside the geometry. The
underlying footprint data is not yet available for every kommune;
a building in an uncovered kommune, or a buildingNumber that does
not exist on the property, returns 404.

Product page: [Bygningsomriss](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/bygningsomriss).

parameters.name: buildingNumber
parameters.description: Bygningsnummer within the property, as returned by listPropertyBuildings.

get.description:
Returns a company by its country code and register identifier, with
links to its sub-resources: properties, roles, shareholders,
group structure, financial statements and premises.

Product page: [Selskaper](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/selskaper).

value.name: Eksempel Eiendom AS
value.naceName: Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom ellers

value.name: Exempel Fastigheter AB
value.naceName: Uthyrning och forvaltning av egna eller arrenderade lokaler

get.description:
Lists the properties the company holds a registered ownership
interest in, directly or through a chain of intermediate entities.
Each entry carries the ownership share at the property and the
path of organizations from the queried company down to the
directly owning entity.

Product page: [Selskaper](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/selskaper).

schema.description: Controlled properties wrapped in an object, cursor-paginated.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

get.description:
Lists the company's registered employee count by month, oldest
first, from Brønnøysundregistrenes Enhetsregisteret. observed
distinguishes a confirmed monthly count from an interpolated one.

Product page: [Selskaper](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/selskaper).

schema.description: Employee counts wrapped in an object.

get.description:
Lists the roles (styreleder, daglig leder, ...) registered on the
company in Brønnøysundregistrenes Enhetsregisteret. holder is
always returned, but a Person holder's name is included only when
the caller also holds the person:read scope; without it, name is
omitted and only birthYear (when known) is returned, matching the
property owner endpoints.

Product page: [Roller](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/roller).

Lists the entries in the company's aksjonærregister. A Person
shareholder's name is included only when the caller also holds
the person:read scope; without it, name is omitted and only
birthYear (when known) is returned, matching the property owner
endpoints. isUltimateBeneficialOwner flags a shareholder recorded
as a reell rettighetshaver.

Product page: [Aksjonærer](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/aksjonaerer).

Returns the company's position in its konsern (group structure):
its direct parents and subsidiaries, each carrying the ownership
share and its own parents and subsidiaries, recursively.

Product page: [Konsernstruktur](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/konsern).

Lists the company's filed annual financial statements (regnskap),
newest first, from Regnskapsregisteret. yoy compares each
statement to the prior filed year, in percentage points.

Product page: [Regnskap](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/regnskap).

schema.description: Financial statements wrapped in an object.

items.description: One entry per fiscal year, newest first.

get.description:
Lists the properties the company has registered as a business
address (forretningsadresse), current and historical, sourced
from Brønnøysundregistrenes Enhetsregisteret and refreshed
nightly. verification has the same shape as a property's tenant
verification: source states whether the premises is confirmed by
the register, observed from other signals, or both.

Product page: [Lokaler](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/lokaler).

Lists documents filed by or about the company: annual reports,
articles of association and other filings from its home register.
Each downloadUrl is a signed URL valid for 15 minutes; request the
list again for a fresh link once it expires.

Product page: [Dokumenter](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/dokumenter).

200.description: Documents filed by or about the company.

get.description:
Returns aggregate statistics for a kommune (4-digit areaId) or
grunnkrets (8-digit areaId): population by gender, age and
education, households by composition, dwellings by type and
tenure, daytime population and commuters, and the income and
wealth bracket distributions. Source: Statistisk sentralbyrå
(SSB) via Geodata's 100 m demography grid, summed over the cells
in the area. Income is alminnelig inntekt and wealth is
nettoformue (taxable), brackets in kNOK. `asOfDate` is the
population year of the release; `populationHistory` has one point
per release loaded.

Norway only. Postal codes share the 4-digit length with
kommunenummer and are not served yet. The market fields
(`transactionsLast12Months`, `medianPricePerM2`, `marketActivity`,
`priceHistory`), `populationProjection`, `medianIncome` and
`totalIncome` have no source yet and are absent from the response.

Product page: [Områdestatistikk](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/omrader).

Lists markanvisningar (land allocation tenders) for the area,
newest first, sourced from Combify for Sweden. Norway has no
equivalent public register, so a Norwegian areaId always
returns an empty list.

Product page: [Markanvisningar](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/markanvisningar).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the register the identifier belongs to. Uppercase.

parameters.name: areaId
parameters.description: Kommunkod (4 digits) for SE; kommunenummer (4 digits), grunnkrets id (8 digits) or postal code (4 digits) for NO, which always returns an empty list.

200.description: Land allocation tenders for the area.

schema.description: Land allocation tenders wrapped in an object, cursor-paginated.

items.description: One entry per tender, newest first.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

post.description:
Creates a subscription that delivers change events for one
property or company as signed CloudEvents 1.0 webhooks.
Idempotency-Key replays the same response to a retried request
for 24 hours.

Each delivery is a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope: specversion "1.0",
a type like "no.placepoint.property.owner_changed", source
identifying the subscription, id, time and data holding the
changed resource. The request carries a Placepoint-Signature
header shaped `t=<unix-timestamp>,v1=<hex-signature>`, where
signature is the hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256, keyed on secret, of
the string formed by joining t and the raw request body with
a period. The receiver can verify authenticity before
trusting the payload. A failed delivery
retries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours; delivery
is at-least-once, so a receiver must handle a duplicate event
by id.

Product page: [Varsler](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/varsler).

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint events are delivered to.

secret.description: Shared secret used to sign delivered payloads. Never returned by the API.

get.description:
Lists the caller's active and paused subscriptions.

Product page: [Varsler](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/varsler).

delete.description:
Deletes a subscription. Delivery stops immediately and the id cannot be reused.

Product page: [Varsler](https://docs.placepoint.no/api/varsler).

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The id returned when the subscription was created.

post.description:
Exchanges client credentials for a bearer access token, the
OAuth 2 client-credentials grant (RFC 6749 section 4.4). The
request body is application/x-www-form-urlencoded with the
wire names RFC 6749 mandates (grant_type, client_id,
client_secret, scope); those four field names, and the
token-response fields access_token, token_type and
expires_in, are the platform's only snake_case exception to
its camelCase convention.

A failed grant returns 400 with an RFC 6749 section 5.2 error
body (application/json, not Problem Details): this is the one
endpoint where the OAuth spec, not api-design/README.md,
defines the error contract.

client_id.description: The client identifier issued at onboarding.

client_secret.description: The client secret issued at onboarding. Never returned by the API.

scope.description: Space-delimited scopes to request; defaults to every scope granted to the client.

400.description: The grant request was rejected, RFC 6749 section 5.2.

get.description:
Returns the identity, tier and quota usage of the client
credentials making the request: which scopes are granted, the
daily call limit, and how many calls have been made so far
this calendar day, UTC, resets at 00:00 UTC.

200.description: The caller's identity and quota usage.

oauth2.description: Client-credentials grant at /auth/token. Scopes are <resource>:<action>, singular resource, colon-separated, the same names the gateway enforces today.

scopes.person:read: Person fields on owners, roles and shareholders (PII tier).
scopes.area:read: Read area statistics and land allocations.

country.name: country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the register the identifier belongs to. Uppercase.

cadastreId.name: cadastreId
cadastreId.description:
Cadastre identifier in the country's register. Norway is matrikkelnummer
knr-gnr-bnr[-fnr[-snr]]; Sweden is fastighetsbeteckning slugged.
Sweden: the fastighetsbeteckning slug as Combify serves it, e.g.
0184_svardsliljan_1_1.

areaId.name: areaId
areaId.description: Kommunenummer (4 digits) or grunnkretsnummer (8 digits) for NO; kommunkod for SE. A 4-digit id is always read as a kommunenummer; postal codes are not served yet.

orgId.name: id
orgId.description: The register's own identifier, digits only.

pageToken.name: pageToken
pageToken.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's nextPageToken.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID; the same key replays the same response for 24 hours.

BadRequest.description: The request body or a parameter failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, expired or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the scope this operation needs.

NotFound.description: No such resource in the served registers.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or daily quota exceeded; see the RateLimit headers.

InternalError.description: Something failed on our side; quote traceId to support.

detail.description: What went wrong in this instance.

traceId.description: Trace id to quote to support.

OrganizationIdentifier.description: The country of the register plus the register's own id.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the register. NO is Brønnøysundregistrene, SE is Bolagsverket.

Person.description: A natural person. Personal data; returned only with the person:read scope, otherwise name is omitted.

Party.description: A natural person or a legal entity; which nested object is populated follows kind.

interestType.description: The interest the grunnbok records, e.g. Hjemmelshaver or Fester.

contactRole.description: Registered contact role, where the party is recorded as a contact rather than a holder.

untilDate.description: When the interest ended. Absent means the interest is current, which is the only way to tell a former owner from a present one.

Address.description: A postal address on a property.

cadastreId.description: The property the address belongs to.

countyName.description: Fylke (Norway) or län (Sweden) the municipality belongs to.

cityDistrictName.description: Bydel, where the municipality is divided into them.

Property.description: A cadastral unit with its plots and addresses.

areaM2.description: Registered plot area in square meters.

totalUsableAreaM2.description: Usable floor area (bruksareal) summed over the buildings, in square meters.

totalGrossAreaM2.description: Gross floor area (bruttoareal) summed over the buildings, in square meters.

builtOverAreaM2.description: Built-over area (bebygd areal, BYA) in square meters.

builtOverAreaPct.description: Built-over area as a percentage of the plot area.

averageFloors.description: Average floor count across the buildings.

establishedDate.description: When the cadastral unit was established in the register.

facilityType.description: Registered facility type (formål) for the cadastral unit.

purposeType.description: Registered purpose (bruksnavn/formål) for the cadastral unit.

otherUnitTypeCode.description: Register code for a unit type that is none of the standard property types.

landRegistryName.description: Name the grunnbok carries for the unit, where it differs from the address.

landUse.description: Dominant AR5 land-use class over the property's teiger. The set follows AR5 and grows; treat an unknown value as OTHER.

leaseholdCount.description: Active leasehold plots (festetomter) on the property.

hasParkingGarage.description: Whether a parking garage is registered on the property.

historicalReportedAreaM2.description: Previously reported plot area in square meters, where the register has revised it.

historicalReportedAreaSourceCode.description: Register code for where the historical area came from.

tenantSummary.description: Companies with a registered business address on the property, counted so a client does not have to page every tenant. The tenants themselves are on listPropertyTenants.

companiesWithEmployeesCount.description: Of those, how many report at least one employee.

supplements.description: Matrikkel supplement flags (opplysninger) on the cadastral unit. Each is registered by the kommune; an absent flag means the register says nothing, not that the condition is false.

hasGroundPollution.description: Ground pollution is registered on the unit.

hasCulturalHeritage.description: A cultural-heritage interest is registered on the unit.

hasNotedComplaint.description: A complaint (klage) is noted on the unit.

hasActiveLeaseholdPlots.description: The unit has active leasehold plots.

hasAgreementBoundaryPointLease.description: An agreement on boundary or point lease is registered.

hasAgreementSiteSpecificRight.description: A site-specific right is registered by agreement.

pointLease.description: The unit is a point lease (punktfeste).

sectioned.description: The unit is divided into eierseksjoner.

underMergerRemains.description: The unit remains after a merger (sammenslåing).

underMergerExpires.description: The unit expires through a merger.

partOfConsolidatedRealEstate.description: The unit is part of a consolidated property.

createdOnASeparateBasis.description: The unit was created on a separate basis.

measurementNotCompleted.description: Surveying of the unit is not completed.

cadastralRecordingDeficiency.description: A deficiency in the cadastral recording is registered.

registryOfDeeds.description: The unit is recorded in the older registry of deeds (grunnboksblad).

Building.description: A building (bygning) registered on a property.

primaryCode.description: Primary type code, the first level of the register's own two-level classification.

subCode.description: Sub-type code within the primary code.

grossAreaM2.description: Gross floor area (bruttoareal) in square meters.

usableAreaM2.description: Usable floor area (bruksareal) in square meters.

residentialUsableAreaM2.description: Usable floor area used for housing, in square meters.

otherUsableAreaM2.description: Usable floor area used for anything but housing, in square meters.

builtOverAreaM2.description: Built-over area (bebygd areal, BYA) in square meters.

builtOverAreaPct.description: Built-over area as a percentage of the plot area.

hasLift.description: Whether the building is registered with a lift.

usageGroup.description: Industry group the registered building type belongs to.

registrationOrigin.description: How the building entered the register.

isCulturalHeritage.description: Whether the building is registered as a cultural heritage site.

isSefrakRegistered.description: Whether the building is in SEFRAK, the register of buildings from before 1900.

sequenceNumber.description: The building's sequence number (løpenummer) within the property.

extensionTypeCode.description: Register code for an extension (tilbygg) relationship to another building.

isAreaIncomplete.description: Whether the register itself flags the area figures as incomplete. When true, a zero or absent area means unmeasured rather than nothing built.

isWithoutBuiltUpArea.description: Whether the building is registered as having no built-up area.

hasSprinklerSystem.description: Whether the building is registered with an automatic fire-suppression system. Absent means no source covers the building, not that it has none.

derivedUsage.description: What Placepoint's classifier reads the building as, from footprint, height and surroundings. Derived, not registered: buildingType is what the register says, and the two disagree most often on older commercial stock. The set grows; treat an unknown value as OTHER.

floorDetails.description: Registered floors, lowest first. floors carries the count.

BuildingElevation.description: Measured heights for a building, in meters.

baseElevationM.description: Ground elevation at the building, in meters above sea level.

highestPointM.description: Highest measured point of the building, in meters above sea level.

heightAboveGroundM.description: Building height above ground, in meters.

BuildingStatusChange.description: One registered change of a building's construction status.

status.description: The status the building changed to.

registeredDate.description: When the register recorded the change.

reason.description: Registered reason for the change, e.g. Ferdigattest.

Floor.description: One registered floor in a building.

usableAreaM2.description: Usable floor area on the floor, in square meters.

Unit.description: A residential or commercial unit (bruksenhet) within a building.

buildingNumber.description: The building the unit belongs to.

cadastreId.description: The unit's own matrikkelnummer, where it is registered as a section.

primaryRoomAreaM2.description: Primary room area (P-ROM) in square meters.

energyLabel.description: Energy label for the unit, where an energiattest exists.

toBeDecommissioned.description: Whether the register has flagged the unit to be removed.

bedroomCount.description: Bedrooms in the unit, where roomCount counts all rooms.

animalsAllowed.description: Whether the cooperative or association permits pets.

cooperativeShareNumber.description: The unit's share number (andelsnummer) in its housing cooperative.

Section.description: An eierseksjon (ownership section) of a property, with its ownership share and owners.

cadastreId.description: The property the section belongs to.

owners.description: Rights holders. A Person owner's name is included only with the person:read scope; otherwise it is omitted.

Verification.description: How confident Placepoint is that a tenancy or premises registration still holds.

source.description: Where the signal comes from: ENHETSREGISTERET for Norway, BOLAGSVERKET for Sweden, OBSERVED or BOTH when corroborated by other signals.

lastSeenAt.description: When the signal was last confirmed.

Tenant.description: A company with a registered business address on the property, from Enhetsregisteret.

unitNumber.description: The unit the tenant occupies, when known.

movedInDate.description: When the company registered this address.

isOwner.description: Whether the company also holds a registered ownership interest in the property.

Transaction.description: A recorded sale of the property or a share of it.

buyers.description: Buyers. A Person buyer's name is included only with the person:read scope.

sellers.description: Sellers. A Person seller's name is included only with the person:read scope.

source.description: Register behind the transaction: KARTVERKET_TINGLYSING for Norway, LANTMATERIET for Sweden.

sectionNumber.description: The section transferred, where the transaction covers one eierseksjon.

advertisedOnOpenMarket.description: Whether the register records the sale as advertised on the open market.

instrumentType.description: The legal instrument behind the transfer, e.g. Skjøte. Narrower than kind, which groups instruments into transaction types.

documentStatusCode.description: Register status code for the document.

transferTaxReason.description: Registered reason for the transfer-tax treatment, e.g. an exemption.

isHistorical.description: Whether the entry has been superseded by a later registration.

ComparableTransaction.description: A comparable transaction, a Transaction plus how it compares to the subject property.

distanceM.description: Distance from the subject property in meters.

Valuation.description: The current estimated value and rent for a property.

rent.description: Estimated rent, when the property type supports a rent estimate.

modelEstimates.description: The individual model outputs behind the headline estimate. value carries the ensemble Placepoint stands behind; these say how it was reached and how much the models disagree.

model.description: Which model produced the figure. The set grows as models are added; treat an unknown value as one we do not document yet.

method.description: Valuation method, e.g. AVM or MANUAL.

EnergyCertificate.description: An energiattest for a building on the property, from Enova.

label.description: Energy label, A best to G worst.

source.description: Leverandør behind the certificate: ENOVA for Norway, BOVERKET for Sweden.

certificateNumber.description: Certificate number in the source register.

unitNumber.description: The unit the certificate covers, where it covers one bruksenhet.

buildingAreaM2.description: The area the certificate was calculated for, in square meters.

deliveredEnergyKwhM2.description: Calculated delivered energy per square meter per year, in kWh.

documentUrl.description: Signed URL to the certificate PDF, valid for 15 minutes.

Certification.description: An environmental certification held by a building on the property.

scheme.description: Certification scheme. The set grows as new schemes are added; treat an unknown value as one we do not document yet.

rating.description: Rating within the scheme, e.g. Very Good.

certificateNumber.description: Licence or certificate number in the scheme's own register.

purpose.description: Permitted purpose, e.g. Bolig og forretning.

planType.description: Which level of plan this is. AREA_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN is a VPOR and PLANNING_PROGRAM a planprogram; both bind development without being reguleringsplaner. The set grows as municipalities digitize more plan kinds; treat an unknown value as OTHER.

verticalLevel.description: Vertical level the plan applies to, e.g. På grunnen.

utilizationValue.description: Utilization figure the plan sets for the area.

inEffectDate.description: When the plan came into effect.

considerationZones.description: Hensynssoner covering the property, from the plan.

proposedBy.description: Who proposed the plan, e.g. Privat or Kommunen.

finalizedDate.description: When the plan was finalized (vedtatt sluttbehandlet), where that differs from adoptedDate.

minUtilizationValue.description: Minimum utilization the plan requires, where it sets one. utilizationValue carries the maximum.

landUseStatus.description: Registered arealbruksstatus for the plan area.

ownershipForm.description: Registered eierform for the plan area.

firstDigitizedDate.description: When the plan was first digitized into the planregister.

planUrl.description: The plan in the municipality's own planregister.

ConsiderationZone.description: A hensynssone from a zoning plan, marking something that constrains what may be built.

Utilization.description: Permitted and built utilization (utnyttelsesgrad) for the property under its zoning plan.

allowedBya.description: Allowed built-over percentage of plot area (bebygd areal).

builtBya.description: Built-over percentage of plot area today, computed from the registered buildings.

allowedBraM2.description: Allowed gross floor area in square meters.

builtBraM2.description: Built gross floor area in square meters.

remainingBraM2.description: Remaining allowed gross floor area in square meters.

utilizationType.description: Which figure the plan sets, since a plan states one of them rather than all: percentage of built-over area, percentage of gross floor area, or gross floor area per square meter of plot.

minUtilizationValue.description: Minimum utilization the plan requires, where it sets one.

basis.description: What the figures rest on, e.g. the applicable zoning plan.

BuildingPermit.description: A building-permit case for the property. Norway is the kommune case archives Placepoint holds; Sweden is bygglov via Combify.

caseNumber.description: Case number in the source archive.

Encumbrance.description: A heftelse (encumbrance) registered on the property.

Risk.description: Assessed natural-hazard risk for the property.

RiskLevel.description: One hazard's assessed level, with its source register.

level.description: Assessed level. UNKNOWN means the register does not yet cover the property, not that it is risk-free.

source.description: Leverandør behind the assessment, e.g. NVE or DSA.

note.description: Short free-text note from the source register.

HousingCooperative.description: The borettslag, sameie or aksjelag the property's unit belongs to.

unitCount.description: Number of units in the cooperative.

units.description: The property's units that belong to the cooperative.

documents.description: Cooperative documents: annual accounts, articles of association and similar.

Document.description: A document tied to a property, plan, case or tender.

kind.description: Document category. The set grows as new archives are connected; treat an unknown value as OTHER.

downloadUrl.description: Signed download URL, valid for 15 minutes.

GeoJsonFeature.description: A GeoJSON Feature (RFC 7946) carrying a property boundary or building footprint.

properties.description: Feature properties. A building footprint carries heightM (number, meters) and floors (integer); a property boundary leaves this empty.

Company.description: A registered business, extending Organization with company-specific fields.

registeredDate.description: Date the company was registered in its home register.

employeesDate.description: When the employee count was last confirmed by the register.

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier, where the company has one.

marketName.description: Trading name, where it differs from the registered name.

businessActivity.description: Registered description of what the company does.

naceCodeSecondary.description: Second NACE industry code, where the company registers more than one.

mobile.description: Registered mobile number, where it differs from phone.

articlesApprovedDate.description: When the company's articles of association were last approved.

accountingYear.description: The accounting year the register holds as current for the company.

compulsoryLiquidationDate.description: When compulsory liquidation (tvangsavvikling) was registered, which is a different event from a voluntary liquidation.

subUnits.description: Registered sub-units (underenheter). A tenant in a building is often a sub-unit rather than the parent legal entity.

documents.description: Company documents: annual reports and other filings.

ControlledProperty.description: A property the company holds a registered ownership interest in, directly or through a chain of intermediate entities.

path.description: The ownership chain from the queried company down to the owning entity.

Role.description: A registered role (styreleder, daglig leder, ...) held in a company, from Brønnøysundregistrenes Enhetsregisteret.

Shareholder.description: A shareholder entry in a company's aksjonærregister.

shareClass.description: Share class, e.g. A or B.

isUltimateBeneficialOwner.description: Whether the shareholder is recorded as a reell rettighetshaver.

fiscalYear.description: The aksjonærregister year the entry is taken from.

sourceDate.description: When the register data was collected.

GroupNode.description: One node (parent, subsidiary or branch) in a company group structure, recursively describing the chain of ownership.

parents.description: Direct parent entities, empty when the entity has no registered parent.

subsidiaries.description: Direct subsidiaries owned by this entity, empty when it has none.

effectiveSharePct.description: Effective ownership share through the whole chain, as a percentage.

depth.description: Steps from the queried company to this node.

isTerminalNode.description: Whether the chain ends here, with no registered owner above.

FinancialStatement.description: A filed annual financial statement (regnskap) for a company, from Regnskapsregisteret.

employees.description: Average number of employees during the year.

profitMarginPct.description: Net result as a percentage of revenue.

isConsolidated.description: Whether the figures are group figures rather than the parent company alone.

yoy.description: Year-over-year change versus the prior filed statement, in percentage points.

revenuePct.description: Change in revenue versus the prior year, in percentage points.

netResultPct.description: Change in net result versus the prior year, in percentage points.

Premises.description: A business premises (forretningsadresse) the company has registered, current or historical.

unitNumber.description: The unit the company occupies, when known.

sinceDate.description: Date the company registered this premises as its business address.

untilDate.description: When the company deregistered the premises, absent while it is current.

buildingType.description: Registered building type at the address, e.g. Kontorbygning.

EmployeeCount.description: A company's registered employee count for one month, from Brønnøysundregistrenes Enhetsregisteret.

observed.description: Whether the count is a confirmed monthly value rather than interpolated.

AreaStatistics.description: Aggregate statistics for a kommune or grunnkrets, summed over the SSB demography grid cells in the area. Money fields are NOK; bracket labels are kNOK.

id.description: Area identifier, matching the areaId path parameter.

kind.description: Area granularity. POSTAL_CODE is reserved; postal codes are not served yet.

municipality.description: The kommune the area lies in.

populationByAgeGroup.description: Registered population by age group, youngest first.

populationByEducationLevel.description: Registered population by highest completed education level.

populationHistory.description: Registered population per year, oldest first.

populationProjection.description: Projected population per year, from Statistisk sentralbyrå (SSB).

averageAge.description: Average age of the registered population.

daytimePopulation.description: People present in the area during working hours.

commuters.description: Daily commuting across the area boundary.

outbound.description: People commuting out of the area.

averageSize.description: Average number of people per household.

byComposition.description: Households by composition, e.g. couple with children.

housing.description: The housing stock in the area.

averageAreaM2.description: Average dwelling area in square meters.

averageBuiltYear.description: Average year of completion for the dwellings.

byType.description: Dwellings by type, e.g. Enebolig or Blokk.

byTenure.description: Households by tenure: Selveier, Eier borettslagsbolig, Leier.

employeeCount.description: People employed at workplaces in the area.

employedResidents.description: Residents of the area who are employed, wherever they work.

averageIncome.description: Mean alminnelig inntekt per taxpayer in the area, NOK.

incomeDistribution.description: Taxpayers by alminnelig inntekt bracket, kNOK, lowest first. The first bucket is exactly zero; the last is open-ended (1500+).

wealthDistribution.description: Taxpayers by nettoformue (taxable net wealth) bracket, kNOK, lowest first; averageWealth is the mean of the same measure in NOK. The first bucket is exactly zero; the last is open-ended (4000+).

transactionsLast12Months.description: Recorded property transactions in the trailing 12 months.

marketActivity.description: Qualitative transaction-volume tier for the area.

priceHistory.description: Price per square meter per quarter, oldest first.

asOfDate.description: The date the statistics were computed as of.

GroupCount.description: One bucket in a distribution: its label, how many fall in it and its share of the total.

count.description: How many fall in the bucket.

sharePct.description: The bucket's share of the total, as a percentage.

YearValue.description: One year and its value in a time series.

PricePoint.description: Price per square meter for one quarter, with the transaction volume behind it.

dwellingType.description: The dwelling type the figure covers, absent when it covers all types.

LandAllocation.description: A markanvisning (land allocation tender) for a plot, sourced from Combify for Sweden. Norway has no equivalent public register.

SubscriptionTarget.description: The resource whose change events trigger delivery.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Present for both target types.

cadastreId.description: Cadastre identifier, present for a PROPERTY target.

id.description: Register identifier, present for a COMPANY target.

Subscription.description: A subscription to change events for a resource, delivered as signed CloudEvents 1.0 webhooks.

events.description: Event types delivered to this subscription.

webhookUrl.description: The HTTPS endpoint events are delivered to.

TokenResponse.description: An OAuth 2 client-credentials token response (RFC 6749 section 4.4.3). Field names are snake_case, the platform's one exception to camelCase, because they are the wire names the OAuth spec fixes.

access_token.description: Bearer token to use as the Authorization header.

scope.description: Space-delimited scopes granted, when narrower than the client's full grant.

TokenError.description: An RFC 6749 section 5.2 token error response. Used only by createToken; every other error response on this API is RFC 9457 Problem Details.

Me.description: The identity, tier and quota usage of the caller's client credentials.

dailyCallLimit.description: Calls allowed per calendar day, UTC; resets at 00:00 UTC.

callsToday.description: Calls made so far this calendar day, UTC; resets at 00:00 UTC.

ApiCatalog.description: The IETF api-catalog document listing this API with its status, scopes and links to spec, docs and changelog.

tags.name: Companies
tags.description: Everything keyed on an organization identifier.

tags.name: Areas
tags.description: Statistics and tenders for a kommune, grunnkrets or postal code.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Change events delivered as signed CloudEvents webhooks.
